datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Zener-voltage limits are 4.47 V minimum and 4.94 V maximum at IZT = 20 mA and TA = 25 degC; the strict schema records the nominal value as breakdown_voltage.
Maximum zener impedance is 19 ohm at IZT = 20 mA; the datasheet table header states ZZT@IZT=0.25 mA, while the MMSZ5230B row gives IZT = 20 mA.
The datasheet publishes no target-specific tabulated capacitance or reverse-recovery time; the family capacitance figure is not transcribed as a target-specific scalar.
The zener curve points are direct readings from the labelled 4.7 V trace in Fig. 1, not interpolated or fitted.
